item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "If They Attempt a Constitutional Amendment to Extend President Lee's Term, He Won't Complete His Remaining Term" (장동혁 “이 대통령 임기 연장 개헌 시도 땐 남은 임기 못 채울 것”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 28th warned National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik regarding his mention of the possibility of allowing the incumbent president to serve consecutive terms, saying, "Go ahead and try to push through a constitutional amendment for term extension. You won't even finish the remaining term." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 28일 조정식 국회의장의 현직 대통령 연임 가능성 언급에 대해 “임기 연장 개헌 한 번 시도해보라. 남은 임기도 다 채우지 못할 것”이라고 경고했다.)

Jang wrote on Facebook that day, "They keep attaching constitutional amendments to everything, and now they've finally revealed their true colors." He added, "President Lee Jae-myung has yet to respond to demands that he declare he will not seek a consecutive term. The nullification of trials, the May 18 constitutional amendment, and even the constitutional revision regarding the election commission—all of it was ultimately a build-up for a 'term extension amendment.' They made Cho Jung-sik, Lee's former special advisor, the National Assembly Speaker just to keep the presidency going." (장 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “뭐든지 개헌을 갖다 붙이더니 드디어 검은 속내를 드러낸 것”이라며 이렇게 적었다. 장 대표는 이어 “이재명 대통령은 ‘연임하지 않겠다’고 선언하라는 요구에 지금까지도 대답을 하지 않고 있다”며 “재판 취소도, 5·18 개헌도, 심지어 선관위 개헌도, 결국 ‘임기 연장 개헌’의 빌드업이었다. 대통령 계속하려고, 자기 특보였던 조정식을 국회의장 시킨 것”이라고 주장했다.)

PPP lawmakers also joined in the criticism. Lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun said, "The Speaker's advocacy for a constitutional amendment is a legislative coup that sells out national sovereignty to power. Speaker Cho must immediately retract his remarks." Lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun reacted, saying, "This proves to the world that the constitutional amendments the government and ruling party have been pushing for were not good-faith efforts for the people, but rather a strategic tool driven by President Lee Jae-myung's ambition for prolonged rule and power extension." (국민의힘 의원들도 일제히 비판했다. 윤상현 의원은 “국회의장의 개헌론은 국민주권을 권력에게 팔아먹는 입법쿠데타”라며 “조 의장은 해당 발언을 즉각 철회하라”고 했다. 김기현 의원은 “(정부·여당이) 외쳐온 개헌이 국민을 위한 선의가 아니라 오직 이재명 대통령의 장기 집권과 권력 연장을 위한 야욕의 정략적 도구였음을 천하에 입증한 것”이라고 반발했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon criticized, "This is the Lee Jae-myung regime preparing a 'Plan B: Constitutional Amendment for Lee's Consecutive Term' in case 'Plan A: Dropping the Indictment of Lee Jae-myung' becomes difficult." Han added, "This is a path to an absolutely unacceptable dictatorship. Whether the judicial system collapses, the stock market crashes, or the real estate market crumbles, the government and ruling party are obsessed only with saving Lee Jae-myung, rather than the lives of the people." (한동훈 무소속 의원은 “플랜에이(A) ‘이재명 공소취소’가 어려워질 때를 대비하여 플랜비(B) ‘이재명 연임 개헌’을 준비하는 이재명 정권”이라고 비판했다. 한 의원은 그러면서 “절대 용납할 수 없는 독재로 가는 길”이라며 “(정부·여당이) 사법제도가 붕괴하든 주식시장이 망가지든 부동산시장이 무너지든 국민의 삶보다는 이재명 살리기에만 몰두하고 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier that morning, during his first press conference as Speaker at the National Assembly's Sarangjae, Cho Woo-won-shik addressed the possibility of a constitutional amendment for a consecutive presidential term, saying, "Isn't it premature to discuss this?" while also stating, "Regarding the restructuring of the power structure, the issue of the incumbent president's consecutive term is ultimately a matter for the sovereign people to decide." (앞서 조 의장은 이날 오전 국회 사랑재에서 열린 취임 첫 기자간담회에서 현직 대통령 연임 개헌 가능성에 대해 “이러쿵저러쿵 시기상조 아닌가”라면서도 “권력 구조 개편과 관련해서 현직 대통령 연임 문제는 결국 주권자인 국민의 선택 문제”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lula embraces President Lee in ‘140-minute talks’…Expanding cooperation in rare earths and more (이 대통령 껴안은 룰라 ‘140분 회담’…희토류 등 협력 확대)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Brazil, adopted a ‘Korea-Brazil Joint Statement’ on the 27th (local time) after discussing strengthened cooperation with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in areas such as trade and investment, resources and energy, defense, space, and aviation. <<> In the meeting, the two leaders agreed to “further strengthen bilateral cooperation as strategic partners linking Latin America and Asia to respond to complex challenges in the international community,” Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung said in a briefing. <<> First, in the context of growing uncertainty in the international trade environment, the two leaders agreed that negotiations for the Korea-Mercosur (Southern Common Market) Trade Agreement (TA) are a key foundation for a new leap in bilateral economic cooperation and decided to advance them. The Korea-Mercosur Trade Agreement, aimed at expanding trade with Brazil and other South American common markets, is expected to help South Korean companies enter the South American market and diversify the supply chain for critical minerals if prolonged stalled negotiations resume. <<> To that end, they agreed to establish a Korea-Brazil bilateral working group to announce the resumption of negotiations at the 69th Mercosur Summit to be held in December. The representatives from each side will be Policy Planning Director Kim Yong-beom and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, respectively. <<> Additionally, the two leaders agreed to expand mutually beneficial cooperation across the entire supply chain of critical minerals, including rare earths, by linking Brazil's abundant critical mineral resources with South Korea's advanced industrial and technological capabilities, and to actively support the establishment of intergovernmental cooperation channels and business-to-business collaboration. <<> President Lee held a summit meeting with President Lula that far exceeded the scheduled time, lasting 140 minutes. The two leaders, who share the common background of being 'former child laborers,' showed special affection for each other throughout the meeting. When President Lee and his wife arrived at the Alvorada Palace, President Lula's official residence, Lula embraced Lee with open arms. This marked the fourth time Lula has held a summit meeting at the residence, following Chinese President Xi Jinping, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and former French President Jacques Chirac. <<> In a joint press statement, President Lula made a 'surprise invitation' to President Lee, saying, “As a symbol of the technical cooperation we can pursue going forward, we will have the opportunity to jointly launch a new launch vehicle at the Alcântara Launch Center in September, and I hope you can attend in person.” President Lee responded, "I would like to come and see it firsthand, but if that’s difficult, I will at least check it via video." <<> President Lee also mentioned their shared experience as factory workers. He said, “Just as the President is missing a finger on his left hand, I also injured my left hand while working in a factory as a child. Although I have a disability from injuring my left arm, this doesn’t hinder me from working for life or for the people of the world. It makes me think of the duty to constantly think of more people and ensure that an overwhelming majority can live better lives.” President Lee added, “When I visit São Paulo tomorrow, I plan to visit the metalworkers' union office where President Lula worked in his youth. I hope that neither the President nor I lose our worker identity and continue to work together for a better life for more people going forward.” After the joint press statement and a commemorative photo, Lula was the first to make a 'finger heart' gesture, and President Lee smiled and made the same gesture. The presidential couple concluded their summit schedule that evening by attending a cultural performance and reception hosted by President Lula and his wife at the Itamaraty Palace, Brazil’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs. <<> Brasília/Seo Young-ji reporter yj@hani.co.kr (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 27일(현지시각) 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 대통령과 교역·투자, 자원·에너지, 방산·우주·항공 등 분야에서 협력 강화를 논의한 뒤 ‘한-브라질 정상 공동성명’을 채택했다.)

item.title: Yang Hyang-ja: "People Power Party Bears Responsibility for Failing to Offer Proper Options to the Public" (양향자 “국힘, 국민에 제대로 된 선택지 못 준 책임 있어”)
item.description:
Regarding the situation where the People Power Party would have to return the 39.7 billion won in election expenses it received after the 2022 presidential election if the Supreme Court upholds the first-instance verdict against former President Yoon Suk-yeol for violating the Public Official Election Act, People Power Party Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja stated, "We need to wait for the Supreme Court's decision," but added, "Apart from the final court ruling, the political responsibility is very heavy." This implies that the People Power Party also bears responsibility for failing to properly vet its candidate. (윤석열 전 대통령의 공직선거법 위반 혐의 1심 선고가 대법원에서 확정될 경우 국민의힘이 2022년 대선 당시 보전받은 선거비용 397억원을 반환해야 하는 데 대해 양향자 국민의힘 최고위원이 “대법원까지 지켜봐야 한다”면서도 “법원의 최종 판단과 별개로 정치적 책임이 매우 무겁다”고 말했다. 후보를 제대로 검증하지 못한 국민의힘에도 책임이 있다는 취지다.)

On the 28th, Supreme Council member Yang said on Channel A's 'Political Signal,' "It's not that the people made the wrong choice, but that the party failed to provide the people with a properly prepared option, and we cannot be free from that responsibility." (양 최고위원은 28일 채널에이(A) ‘정치시그널’에서 “국민이 잘못 선택한 것이 아니라 정당이 국민께 제대로 준비된 선택지를 드리지 못한 책임에서 자유롭지 못하다”며 이같이 말했다.)

She continued, "The responsibility should not be placed solely on former President Yoon," adding, "It’s the failure of our party, which did not properly vet him, of our politicians who, driven by the desire to win, ignored the warning signs, and of all of us who prioritized loyalty to one person over the party's values." (이어 “책임을 윤 전 대통령 개인에게만 돌려서도 안 된다”며 “(후보를) 제대로 검증하지 못한 우리 당, 승리에 급급해서 경고음을 외면한 우리 정치인들, 한 사람에 대한 충성을 당의 가치보다 앞세운 우리 모두의 실패”라고 말했다.)

Supreme Council member Yang added, "Going forward, we must create a party that can properly nurture and vet people, and clearly warn against wrongdoing, even if it’s within the same party," and said, "We must reflect painfully, but I believe our responsibility extends not just to reflection but to changing the system and culture." (양 최고위원은 “앞으로는 사람을 제대로 육성하고 검증하고 잘못된 권력에는 같은 당이라도 분명히 경고할 수 있는 정당을 만들어야 한다”며 “뼈아프게 반성하되 그 반성에 머무르지 않고 제도와 문화를 바꾸는 것까지가 우리의 책임이라고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 27th, the 21st Criminal Division of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Jo Soon-pyo) sentenced former President Yoon to one year and six months in prison, suspended for three years, for violating the Public Official Election Act. The court deemed as 'false' all of former President Yoon's explanations regarding the suspicions of 'introducing a lawyer' and a 'connection to a shaman' raised during the 20th presidential election campaign. (앞서 서울중앙지법 형사21부(재판장 조순표)는 27일 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 기소된 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 1년6개월에 집행유예 3년을 선고했다. 제20대 대선 후보 시절 제기된 ‘변호사 소개’ 및 ‘무속인 인연’ 의혹에 대한 윤석열 전 대통령의 해명을 모두 ‘허위’로 판단한 것이다.)

Under election law, if a presidential candidate is elected or receives more than 15% of the vote, the National Election Commission reimburses the full election expenses. However, if the candidate is sentenced to a penalty that would nullify the election (a fine of 1 million won or more) and the verdict is finalized, the political party must return the full amount. The Supreme Court's ruling is expected as early as January next year. Former President Yoon is the first former president to receive a sentence that would nullify the election for violating election law. (선거법에 따라 대선 후보자가 당선되거나 15% 이상의 득표율을 얻으면 중앙선거관리위원회로부터 선거비용 전액을 보전받는데, 당선 무효형(벌금 100만원 이상)을 선고받아 확정되면 정당이 이를 전액 반환해야 한다. 대법원 판결은 이르면 내년 1월 나올 전망이다. 선거법 위반 혐의로 당선무효형을 선고받은 전직 대통령은 윤 전 대통령이 처음이다.)

As the People Power Party faces having to fully return the 39.7 billion won, Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 27th, "This is a just retribution for the mistake of recommending a candidate who was unqualified, giving rise to a prosecutorial dictatorship regime, and fundamentally shaking South Korea’s constitutional order." (국민의힘이 397억원을 고스란히 반환할 처지에 놓이자 한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 27일 “자격 미달인 후보를 추천해 검찰독재정권을 탄생시키고, 대한민국 헌정질서를 뿌리째 뒤흔든 과오에 대한 당연한 응보”라고 말했다.)

The People Power Party tried to turn the tables against the Democratic Party. Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon of the People Power Party, bringing up the case where Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung was indicted for allegedly claiming he didn't know former Seongnam Urban Development Corporation head Kim Moon-ki during the 2022 presidential election and is undergoing trial, argued on the 27th, "Our case is at the first instance, while the Democratic Party's case involving Leader Lee has been sent back for retrial from the Supreme Court with an effectively finalized guilty verdict, and the amount is even larger. If we have to sell our party headquarters, it’s only right that the Democratic Party sells theirs first." (국민의힘은 화살을 민주당 쪽으로 돌리려 했다. 박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 27일 이재명 대통령이 2022년 대선 당시 김문기 전 성남도시개발공사 처장을 몰랐다고 한 혐의 등으로 기소돼 재판을 받아온 사건을 거론하며 “저희는 1심이고, 민주당은 이재명 대통령 건에 대해서는 대법원의 사실상 확정판결에 준하는 유죄 취지 파기 환송으로, 금액도 더 크다. 당사를 팔아야 한다면 민주당 당사를 먼저 파는 게 맞다”고 공세를 폈다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Fast Track Period Shortened from 330 to 90 Days’: National Assembly Act Passes Operations Subcommittee (‘패스트트랙 기간 330→90일 단축’ 국회법, 운영위 소위 통과)
item.description:
The National Assembly’s Operations Improvement Subcommittee of the Steering Committee passed an amendment to the National Assembly Act on the 28th, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, reducing the review period for fast-track bills from 330 days to 90 days. (국회 운영위원회 국회운영개선소위원회가 28일 더불어민주당 주도로 신속처리안건(패스트트랙)의 심사 기간을 330일에서 90일로 줄이는 국회법 개정안을 의결했다. )

Cheon Jun-ho, a Democratic Party member and chair of the National Assembly Operations Improvement Subcommittee, met with reporters at the National Assembly and said, “Typically, the fast track takes about 330 days for review, but the current legislative processing deadline is shorter than that. Since bills are being reviewed and processed within about 300 days, we determined there is a need to shorten the processing period to match the purpose and name of this system.” (민주당 소속인 천준호 국회운영개선소위원장은 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “보통 패스트트랙이 (심사에) 330일 정도 소요되는데 현재 법안 처리 시한이 그보다 짧다”며 “약 300여일 정도 안에 법안이 심사·처리되고 있기 때문에 이 제도의 취지와 이름에 걸맞게 처리 기간을 단축할 필요가 있다고 판단했다”고 말했다.)

Under the current National Assembly Act, fast-track bills take up to 330 days: 180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days for plenary session referral. However, the amendment reduces the review period to a maximum of 90 days, with 60 days for standing committees, 30 days for the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and referral to the first plenary session after passing the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik also said at a press briefing that day regarding the fast-track system, “There are criticisms that it has become ineffective or that the maximum review period of nearly a year, 330 days, is too long, and we need to examine this reasonably.” The People Power Party opposed the bill’s passage and walked out before the vote. Kim Seung-soo, the deputy floor leader for legislative affairs, said, “It’s a declaration of war to reenact the majority ruling party’s parliamentary violence.” The People Power Party is considering launching a filibuster (legal obstruction of proceedings through unlimited debate) if the Democratic Party puts the National Assembly Act amendment on the agenda for the plenary session on the 30th. <<> Meanwhile, the National Assembly Operations Improvement Subcommittee decided to continue reviewing revisions to the filibuster system. Currently, a filibuster can be ended if more than three-fifths of all members approve. The Democratic Party is considering lowering the threshold to end a filibuster to one-fifth of all members. The day before, Democratic Party floor leader Park Chan-dae said, “Since the 22nd National Assembly began, the People Power Party has abused the filibuster a total of 32 times,” adding, “A system designed to protect minority opinions is paralyzing the National Assembly.” (지금 국회법엔 패스트트랙 안건은 상임위 180일, 법제사법위원회 90일, 본회의 부의 60일 등 심사에 최장 330일이 걸린다. 그러나 개정안은 ‘상임위 60일, 법사위 30일, 법사위 전체회의 통과 뒤 열리는 첫 본회의 상정’으로 심사 기간을 최장 90일로 줄였다. 조정식 국회의장도 이날 기자간담회에서 패스트트랙 제도에 관해 “유명무실화하거나 (최장 심사 기간이) 1년 가까이, 330일 진행되며 너무 긴 것 아니냐는 비판도 있는데 합리적으로 같이 볼 필요는 있다”고 말했다. 국민의힘은 법안 처리에 반발하며 의결 전 퇴장했다. 김승수 원내운영수석부대표는 “다수 여당의 의회 폭거를 재현하겠다는 선전포고”라고 말했다. 국민의힘은 민주당이 오는 30일 본회의에 국회법 개정안을 상정하면 필리버스터(무제한 토론을 통한 합법적 의사진행 방해)에 나서는 방안을 검토 중이다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (이런 가운데 국회운영개선소위는 필리버스터 제도 개편은 좀더 심사를 이어가기로 했다. 지금은 재적의원 5분의 3이상이 찬성하면 필리버스터를 종결할 수 있다. 민주당은 이를 재적의원 5분의 1로 하는 등 필리버스터 해제 요건을 낮추는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 전날 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 “22대 국회 들어 국민의힘이 남발한 필리버스터만 무려 32번”이라며 “소수의 의견을 보호하기 위해 마련한 제도가 국회를 마비시키고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: U.S. Ambassador Michelle Steel to Assume Post This Week… Focus on Coordinating Issues Such as U.S. Investment and Coupang (미셸 스틸 미국대사 금주 부임…대미투자·쿠팡 등 현안 조율 촉각)
item.description:
Michelle Steel, the first U.S. ambassador to South Korea under the second Donald Trump administration, will arrive in Korea on the 30th. With sensitive issues between South Korea and the U.S. piling up—including American investment, tariffs, uranium enrichment and reprocessing, and the Coupang matter—attention is focused on Ambassador Steel’s actions. (도널드 트럼프 2기 행정부의 첫 주한 미국대사인 미셸 스틸 대사가 오는 30일 한국에 부임한다. 대미투자와 관세, 우라늄 농축 재처리와 쿠팡 문제 등 한미 간 껄끄러운 현안이 쌓인 상태라 스틸 대사의 행보에 관심이 쏠린다.)

Ambassador Steel is expected to focus on ensuring that Korea’s investment in the U.S., amounting to $350 billion, moves forward quickly—a key concern for the U.S. Some analysts suggest that U.S. complaints about delayed Korean investment in America are also affecting the delay in negotiations on South Korea-U.S. nuclear cooperation. (스틸 대사는 미국의 주요 관심사인 3500억달러 규모에 이르는 한국의 대미 투자가 신속하게 이뤄지도록 하는 데 주력할 것으로 보인다. 대미투자가 늦어진다는 미국의 불만이 한미 원자력 협상 지연에도 영향을 미치고 있다는 분석도 있다.)

The Coupang issue is also sensitive. Earlier this month, the U.S. House Judiciary Committee argued that “the Korean government is discriminating against Coupang.” There is also interest in what role she will play in conflicts between the two countries over religious issues, including the case of Pastor Son Hyun-bo, who was arrested and later released on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act. Amid these developments, Foreign Minister Kang Kyung-wha made an unusual visit to Korea from the 15th to the 19th to share pending issues between South Korea and the U.S. with the presidential office and various ministries. (쿠팡 문제 역시 민감하다. 이달 초 미 하원 법제사법위원회는 “한국 정부가 쿠팡을 차별하고 있다”고 주장한 바 있다. 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 구속됐다 풀려난 손현보 목사 건을 비롯한 종교 문제 등을 둘러싼 한미 간 갈등 요인에서 그가 어떤 역할을 할지도 관심사다. 이런 가운데 지난 15∼19일 강경화 주미대사가 이례적으로 귀국해 청와대와 각 부처와 한미 현안을 공유하기도 했다.)

Ambassador Steel, a Republican politician, is known to have direct communication with President Trump. (공화당 정치인인 미셸 대사는 트럼프 대통령과 직접 소통할 수 있는 인물로 알려져 있다.)

With the U.S. ambassador to South Korea position filled after being vacant for a year and a half, there are expectations for smoother communication between South Korea and the U.S. However, some express concerns, noting that during her time as a congresswoman, Steel advocated for strengthening U.S. checks on China and improving the human rights of North Korean defectors, and opposed the Moon Jae-in government’s push for an end-of-war declaration between the two Koreas. (1년6개월 동안 공석이던 주한 미국대사 자리가 채워지면서 한미 간 소통이 원활해질 것이란 기대가 있다. 하지만 일각에서는 스틸 대사가 의원 시절 미국의 중국 견제 강화와 탈북민 인권 개선을 주장하고, 문재인 정부가 추진했던 남북 종전선언에 반대했다는 점에서 우려의 목소리도 나온다.)

Ambassador Steel was born in Seoul in 1955 and immigrated to the U.S. in the mid-1970s. She later served two terms as a U.S. House of Representatives member from California. She is the second Korean-American U.S. ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim (2011-2014). (스틸 대사는 1955년 서울에서 태어나 1970년대 중반 미국으로 이민갔다. 이후 캘리포니아주에서 두차례 연방 하원의원을 지냈다. 한국계 주한 미국대사는 성 김 전 대사(2011∼2014년)에 이어 두 번째다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "If President Lee Pushes for Re-election Constitutional Amendment, That Would Be a True Insurrection" (장동혁 “이 대통령, 연임 개헌 추진하면 그거야말로 진정한 내란”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, said on the 28th, "If President Lee Jae-myung defies the will of the people, defies the current spirit of the constitution, and truly pursues a constitutional amendment for re-election, that in itself would be a genuine insurrection." This came in response to National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's morning press briefing, where he stated that "a constitutional amendment allowing a sitting president's re-election is a matter of the people's choice," to which Jang retorted that "a re-election constitutional amendment is an insurrection." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 28일 “이재명 대통령이 국민의 뜻을 거스르고, 지금의 헌법 정신을 거스르고, 정말 연임 개헌을 추진한다면 그것이 바로 진정한 내란이 될 것”이라고 말했다. 조정식 국회의장이 이날 오전 기자간담회에서 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌은 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말한 데 대해 ‘연임 개헌은 내란’이라고 반발한 것이다.)

Assemblyman Jang held an emergency press conference at the National Assembly that afternoon, saying, "President Lee Jae-myung took Assemblyman Woo Won-shik as a special adviser (to the Presidential Office), and it seems he gave him special training to push forward this kind of constitutional amendment." (장 대표는 이날 오후 국회에서 긴급기자회견을 열어 “이재명 대통령이 조정식 의원을 (청와대) 특보로 데려가더니 이런 개헌을 하기 위한 특별 교육을 시켰나보다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Assemblyman Jang asserted, "The abolition of supplementary investigative powers has stirred up the nation, and the 'Mutual Mortgage' on real estate is fueling public anger to the skies. Today, the KOSPI fell 11%, barely holding onto the 6000 mark. In the year since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, it has wrecked every system in South Korea, and the stock market has become a hellfire." He added, "There's already talk that the next four years will be long. How much more do they intend to destroy South Korea and plunge the people into suffering, by bringing up Lee Jae-myung's re-election at this very moment?" (장 대표는 “보완수사권 폐지 때문에 대한민국이 떠들썩하고, 부동산 ‘더불어근저당’으로 국민 분노가 하늘 찌르고 있다. 오늘 코스피가 11% 하락하면서 6000선을 가까스로 지켰다”며 “이재명 정부가 들어서 1년 동안 대한민국 모든 시스템을 망가뜨리고, 주식시장은 이제 지옥불이 됐다”고 주장했다. 그러면서 “앞으로 4년도 길다는 이야기가 나오고 있는데 대한민국을 얼마나 더 무너뜨리고 국민을 얼마나 더 고통에 빠뜨리려고 지금 이 순간에 이재명 연임을 이야기하고 있나”고 했다.)

Assemblyman Jang claimed, "The Democratic Party has always brought up a one-point constitutional amendment whenever we talked about the spirit of the May 18th Gwangju Uprising or election commission reform. Knowing their true intentions, I've repeatedly said that if President Lee Jae-myung would just state unequivocally that he'll never seek re-election, regardless of whether it's a one-point amendment or any other constitutional change, it would be easier to trust his sincerity and begin discussions on the amendment. Now, they've finally revealed their true colors." He continued, "In the end, it was just a matter of them testing the waters here and there to pursue re-election. There's nothing else in their heads." (장 대표는 “(민주당은) 그동안 5·18 정신, 선관위 개혁을 얘기할 때마다 원포인트 개헌을 얘기했다. 그 속내를 알고 있기 때문에 원포인트 개헌이든 무슨 개헌이든 이재명 대통령이 절대 연임 안 하겠다는 말만 하면 그 진정성을 믿고 개헌 논의에 착수하기 더 쉬울 거라는 얘기를 계속했는데, 드디어 속내를 드러냈다”고 주장했다. 이어 “결국 연임하기 위해 여기저기 찔러봤던 것밖에 안 된다. 그거 외에 머릿속에 아무것도 없다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker’s Office Clarifies on Cho Jung-sik’s Remarks: “Not About Possibility of Incumbent President’s Re-election” (국회의장실, 조정식 발언에 “현직 대통령 연임 가능성 뜻 아냐” 해명)
item.description:
Amid controversy sparked on the 28th by National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik’s mention of the “possibility of the incumbent president’s re-election,” the National Assembly Speaker’s Office issued an official explanation, stating, “This was a statement of principle that constitutional amendments should proceed based on national consensus and political agreement.” <<> Jang Hyun-joo, Senior Secretary for Public Communication at the National Assembly Speaker’s Office, held a briefing at the main building of the National Assembly that afternoon and said, “Speaker Cho is fully aware of the provision (Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution) that stipulates constitutional amendments for extending the presidential term or changing term limits do not apply to the president in office at the time of the proposal.” She added, “Reports suggesting that the possibility of the incumbent president’s re-election was left open are completely different from the intent of the remarks.” <<> Earlier that morning, during his first press conference since taking office, Speaker Cho had said, “Regarding the restructuring of power structures, the issue of the incumbent president’s re-election is a matter of public opinion and choice.” <<> By Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (28일 조정식 국회의장의 ‘현직 대통령 연임 가능성’ 언급이 논란을 일으킨 가운데, 국회의장실은 “개헌은 국민적 공감대와 정치권 합의를 바탕으로 진행돼야 한다는 원론적 입장을 밝힌 것”이라는 공식 해명을 내놓았다.)

item.title: ‘Jang Dong-hyuk’s Praetorian Guard’ Ragged 3-Member Ethics Committee…Dispute Over Legitimacy of Disciplinary Actions Spreads (‘장동혁 친위대’ 누더기 3인 윤리위…징계 정당성 논란 번져)
item.description:
The People Power Party’s Central Ethics Committee, with only the minimum quorum of three members present, decided on the 27th to initiate disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh, sparking growing internal dissent. Critics argue that a decision made by a tiny number of ethics committee members aligned with leader Jang Dong-hyuk’s stance is unlikely to secure legitimacy. <<> Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop said on YTN Radio on the 28th: “The Ethics Committee holds immense power to discipline, and even expel, nationally elected lawmakers, so its composition and procedures must be flawless. But initiating discipline with just a bare quorum of three will lead to problems. It’s not a good thing for it to act as someone’s knife or hunting dog.” <<> Lawmaker Cho Kyoung-tae, who was subject to the disciplinary initiation the previous day, also stated at a National Assembly press conference: “The party constitution and rules stipulate that the Central Ethics Committee should consist of up to nine members. But due to repeated dysfunction from resignations, the decision (to initiate discipline) made yesterday by just three hands lacks procedural legitimacy.” Cho was targeted for disciplinary action for campaigning against the election of National Assembly Vice Speaker candidate Park Deok-heum during the plenary session’s vote for the opposition’s vice speaker. Another lawmaker, who is not strongly factional, commented: “I don’t understand why the Ethics Committee is rushing to impose discipline with only a bare quorum.” The party’s constitution and rules only state that the Ethics Committee should be composed of up to nine members, with no lower limit set. The party leadership cites this as grounds to argue that “the resolution has no issues.” <<> The People Power Party leadership launched the Ethics Committee in January with seven members. However, three Ethics Committee members immediately resigned after their names were made public. The party then appointed two new members, restoring the committee to six. After the June 3 local elections, it appointed media spokesperson Jeong Kyoung-wook, bringing the count back to seven. But recently, conflicts intensified over the operational policy of committee chair Yoon Min-woo, leading two more Ethics Committee members to resign in succession within a week, reducing the total to five. Amid this, Vice Chair Woo Jong-hwan and member Hwang Kyung-sung issued a statement criticizing Yoon Min-woo on the 27th and boycotted the day’s meeting. <<> Within the party, there was backlash from those targeted—who argued the disciplinary initiation targets anti-Jang Dong-hyuk lawmakers—and criticism from non-mainstream members. Lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, facing discipline for supporting independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in the June 3 Busan North-Gap by-election, wrote on Facebook: “What the People Power Party needs is not intimidation-style disciplinary politics for factional control, but to recover public sentiment. The public won’t vote for a party that turns its knives inward.” Cho Kyoung-tae also protested: “History will surely judge the unscrupulous targeted discipline by Jang Dong-hyuk’s private ‘Avatar Committee.’ Is this truly legitimate discipline? Or is it political retaliation to shield party power?” <<> At the floor leaders’ meeting, a heated debate erupted over the disciplinary decision against Kwon Young-jin, who had grabbed the collar of floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik and others after complaining about the allocation of parliamentary standing committee seats. Lawmaker Cho Eun-hee said: “When there’s a sincere apology, we should give a chance to work together again.” In contrast, lawmaker Yoo Young-ha countered: “A party that shields violence because it’s from a comrade cannot exist.” Floor leader Jeong then defused the situation, saying: “Let’s discuss political views privately.” <<> Reported by Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr and Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 지난 27일 최하 정족수인 단 3명의 윤리위원만 참석한 가운데 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 결정한 데 대해 당내 반발이 확산하고 있다. 특히 장동혁 대표의 성향과 일치하는 극소수 윤리위원들의 결정은 정당성을 확보하기 어려운 것 아니냐는 비판이 나온다.)

item.title: Passport, Accelerating Review of Bill to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Rights – Concerns Over ‘Hasty Review’ (여권, 보완수사 폐지안 처리 속도전…‘날림 심사’ 우려도)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, led by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea and affiliated pro-government parties, has launched an expedited review of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill aimed at abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights, targeting a plenary session vote on the 30th. However, the opposition party is protesting that the review of a special counsel bill concerning the election commission, triggered by the shortage of ballot papers, should take precedence, raising expectations of conflict before the bill can be brought to the floor. As the review proceeds under time pressure, concerns over a 'slapdash review' are also emerging. <<> Kim Seung-won, a member of the Democratic Party and chair of the First Subcommittee for Bill Review, stated at a subcommittee plenary meeting on the morning of the 28th, "Negotiations on the special counsel bill for the election commission are still ongoing among the floor leadership of the negotiating groups," putting the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which was originally a lower-priority agenda item, up for review first. In response, Park Hyung-soo of the People Power Party, the opposition party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, objected, saying, "There is a huge difference of opinion between the two parties on the Criminal Procedure Act. There is a risk of failure, so if we discuss the Criminal Procedure Act first and it breaks down, we won't be able to discuss the special counsel bill we promised to the people." Subsequently, People Power Party lawmakers left the meeting room and returned only late in the afternoon to resume the review. <<> The Democratic Party, after holding a general meeting of lawmakers on the 24th to approve the Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights as a party policy, has been speeding up the handling of the bill. The target is to review it in the subcommittee on this day, pass it in the full Legislation and Judiciary Committee meeting on the 29th, and then have it processed in the plenary session on the 30th. <<> However, as the revision process is proceeding hastily, there are criticisms that despite the significant impact of the law on the people, there is insufficient time to properly review the details. For instance, there may be a lack of thorough examination regarding whether supplementary measures reflected in the bill—such as 'substantializing the right to request supplementary investigations' and 'mandating the referral of seven major crimes against socially vulnerable individuals to the prosecution'—conflict with existing laws or whether their effectiveness can be guaranteed. <<> Lawmaker Park Hyung-soo said at the People Power Party's floor strategy meeting on this day, "(The Democratic Party's unilateral bill review) means treating the first opposition party lawmakers as mere voting machines," and added, "If the Democratic Party ignores our warnings and unilaterally puts this bill on the plenary agenda, we will mobilize all means, including unlimited debate, to strongly block it." <<> Meanwhile, the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) announced on this day that it had submitted an opinion to the National Assembly stating that investigative procedures—such as emergency arrests, detention periods, and searches and seizures—should be directly stipulated in the CIO Act. The opinion also included a proposal to establish a new 'additional investigation request' procedure, allowing prosecution investigators to assess the need for supplementary investigations. CIO spokesperson Kim Baek-ki explained, "The aim is to minimize the potential for interpretive disputes by directly regulating investigative procedures in the CIO Act." <<> Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Lim Cheol-hwi hwi@hani.co.kr (국회 법제사법위원회가 더불어민주당 등 범여권 주도로 오는 30일 본회의 처리를 목표로 하는 ‘검사의 보완수사권 폐지’ 형사소송법(형소법) 개정안 심사 ‘속도전’에 들어갔다. 그러나 야당은 ‘투표용지 부족 사태에 따른 선거관리위원회 특검법’ 심사가 먼저라고 반발하고 있어 본회의 상정까지 진통이 예상된다. 처리 시한에 쫓겨서 심사가 진행되다 보니 ‘졸속 심사’에 대한 우려도 나온다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Woo "Presidential Re-election Through Constitutional Amendment Is a Matter of Public Choice" – Constitutional Amendment Debate Causes Stir (조정식 의장 “현직 대통령 연임, 국민 선택”…개헌론 파장)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik stated on the 28th, "The issue of constitutional amendment for a sitting president’s re-election is ultimately a matter of public choice." His remarks, which appeared to leave open the possibility of President Lee Jae-myung’s re-election through a constitutional amendment, drew immediate backlash from the People Power Party, with even the ruling party describing it as a "major blunder and inappropriate comment." (조정식 국회의장이 28일 “현직 대통령 연임의 개헌 문제는 결국 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말했다. 개헌을 통한 이재명 대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어둔 듯한 조 의장의 발언에 국민의힘은 일제히 반발했고, 여당 안에서도 ‘대형 사고이자 부적절한 발언’이라는 반응이 터져 나왔다.)

During his first press conference since taking office at the National Assembly that day, Speaker Woo was asked about the opposition’s opposition to extending the sitting president’s term via constitutional amendment. He responded, "Isn’t it too early to say one way or the other about that?" but added, "Regarding the restructuring of the power structure, issues like constitutional amendment for the sitting president’s re-election are ultimately a matter of public opinion and choice by the sovereign, the people." He further stated, "It depends on how the various political stakeholders reach an agreement. When discussions on constitutional amendment touch on the power structure, it could become an issue. Wouldn’t opinions be gathered through the Constitutional Amendment Advisory Committee or the Special Committee on Constitutional Amendment?" His remarks were interpreted as not ruling out the possibility of President Lee’s re-election through constitutional change. Woo has been considered a key pro-Lee figure within the Democratic Party, having served as President Lee’s special political advisor until May last year. (조 의장은 이날 국회에서 한 취임 뒤 첫 기자간담회에서 ‘야권에서는 현직 대통령의 임기 연장 개헌을 반대하고 있다’는 취지의 물음에 “지금 그에 대해 이렇다 저렇다 얘기하기가 시기상조 아닌가”라면서도 “권력구조 개편 관계에서 현직 대통령의 연임 개헌 문제 등은 결국 주권자인 국민 여론과 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말했다. 그러면서 “여러 정치적 당사자들이 어떻게 합의하느냐에 달린 문제다. 개헌 논의에서 권력구조 문제가 나오면 이슈가 될 수 있을 텐데 개헌자문위나 개헌특위를 통해 의견이 수렴되지 않겠나”라고 했다. 조 의장의 발언은 개헌을 통한 이 대통령의 연임 가능성을 배제하지 않는다는 해석을 낳았다. 조 의장은 더불어민주당 내에서 친이재명계 핵심 인사로 꼽혀왔다. 지난 5월까지는 이 대통령의 정무특별보좌관으로 활동하기도 했다.)

The Constitution (Article 70, etc.) stipulates that the president’s term is five years and that re-election or consecutive terms are prohibited. Even if a constitutional amendment were pursued to extend or allow consecutive terms for the president, Article 128 states that such an amendment has no effect on the president in office at the time of the proposal, preventing a sitting president from extending their own term through constitutional change. (헌법(제70조 등)은 대통령의 임기는 5년으로, 연임이나 중임이 불가하다고 돼 있다. 대통령의 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위해 헌법 개정을 하려 해도 그 헌법 개정 제안 당시의 대통령에 대해서는 효력이 없다는 규정(제128조)이 있어 현직 대통령이 헌법 개정으로 자신의 임기를 연장할 수 없다.)

Woo’s predecessor, former Speaker Woo Won-shik, dismissed the idea of extending the sitting president’s term via constitutional amendment in June last year, stating, "If a constitutional amendment for consecutive terms or presidential term is made, the current president is not subject to it." Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho also responded during a parliamentary audit in October last year regarding "constitutional amendment for presidential re-election," saying, "It is generally correct to interpret that it does not apply to the sitting president." This came amid controversy after Legislation Minister Cho Won-chul, in the same month, suggested that if a constitutional amendment for a four-year, re-electable presidency were passed, it might apply to President Lee, stating, "Isn’t it a matter for the people to decide?" In May last year, the Democratic Party’s deputy spokesperson criticized the then-ruling party’s claims of a "re-election constitutional amendment" as a conspiracy theory, pointing out, "Article 128 of the Constitution clearly states that a constitutional amendment for extending the president’s term or changing consecutive term rules has no effect on the president at the time of the proposal." (전임자인 우원식 의장은 지난해 6월 “중임이나 대통령 임기 관련한 개헌을 할 경우에 당해 대통령은 해당하지 않는다”며 개헌을 통한 현직 대통령 임기 연장을 일축했다. 정성호 법무부 장관 역시 지난해 10월 국정감사에서 ‘대통령 연임제 개헌’에 관해 “통상적으로는 재임 중 대통령에게 적용하지 않는다고 해석하는 것이 맞다”고 답했다. 정 장관의 발언은 같은 달 조원철 법제처장이 대통령 4년 연임제 개헌이 이뤄질 경우 이 대통령부터 적용될지에 관해 “국민이 결단해야 할 문제 아닌가 싶다”고 말해 논란이 이는 가운데 나왔다. 민주당은 지난 5월 당시 원내대변인이 “헌법 제128조는 대통령 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위한 헌법 개정은 그 제안 당시의 대통령에게 효력이 없다고 명확히 규정하고 있다”며 ‘연임용 개헌’이라는 당시 국민의힘의 공세를 음모론이라고 비판했다.)

Speaker Woo’s remarks sparked strong opposition from the opposition People Power Party. Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held an emergency press conference at the National Assembly, saying, "President Lee kept saying he would never seek re-election, but now he’s finally revealed his true intentions. If they push for a re-election constitutional amendment, that would be a true act of insurrection." Floor leader Chung Jeom-sik also stated, "We will not engage in any discussion on constitutional amendment that includes President Lee’s re-election plan." Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon wrote on Facebook, "In case Plan A, ‘dropping charges against Lee Jae-myung,’ becomes difficult, the Lee administration is preparing Plan B, ‘re-election constitutional amendment for Lee Jae-myung.’ This is an unacceptable path toward dictatorship." (조 의장의 발언에 국민의힘 등 야당은 강하게 반발했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 국회에서 긴급기자회견을 열어 “(이 대통령이) 절대 연임하지 않겠다는 말을 계속하더니 드디어 속내를 드러냈다”며 “연임 개헌을 추진한다면 그것이 바로 진정한 내란이 될 것”이라고 말했다. 정점식 원내대표도 “이 대통령의 연임 구상이 포함된 개헌 논의에는 일절 응하지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 한동훈 무소속 의원도 페이스북에 “플랜에이(A) ‘이재명 공소취소’가 어려워질 때를 대비해 플랜비(B) ‘이재명 연임 개헌’을 준비하는 이재명 정권, 절대 용납할 수 없는 독재로 가는 길”이라고 썼다.)

The Democratic Party also appeared visibly taken aback. (민주당도 당혹스러운 기색이 역력하다.)

A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area told The Hankyoreh, "Speaker Woo made a major blunder. He invites the opposition to join the Special Committee on Constitutional Amendment, then makes comments that seem to leave the door open for the sitting president’s re-election—I don’t understand his thinking." A multi-term lawmaker from the Honam region said, "Making a statement that could be seen as implying hope for President Lee’s re-election was inappropriate." Another lawmaker added, "Even if there was no intention to pursue a re-election constitutional amendment, the Speaker’s words left room for doubt, prompting the opposition to become suspicious." A first-term lawmaker remarked, "Some people calling for dropping charges against President Lee have also raised the re-election issue. This is part of the same line of argument by a few. Is this even possible in terms of public opinion? It’s absurd." (한 수도권 다선 의원은 한겨레에 “조 의장이 너무 대형 사고를 쳤다. 야당에 개헌특위에 들어오라고 하고는 현직 대통령 연임 가능성을 열어두는 듯한 발언을 한다는 게 무슨 생각인지 모르겠다”고 말했다. 호남 다선 의원은 “마치 (이 대통령 연임을) 희망이 깔린 것처럼 여겨질 만한 발언을 한 것은 적절치 않다”고 말했다. 다른 의원도 “연임 개헌을 추진할 의도가 없었더라도 여지를 두는 듯한 의장의 말 때문에 야당이 의구심을 갖게 됐다”고 말했다. 한 초선 의원은 “이 대통령의 공소취소를 주장하는 몇몇 인사들이 연임 얘기를 꺼내기도 했는데 동일 선상에 있는 일부의 주장”이라며 “국민 여론상 가능하겠냐. 말도 안 된다”고 했다.)

As controversy grew, the Office of the National Assembly Speaker moved to manage the situation. Senior Press Secretary Jang Hyun-joo told reporters, "Speaker Woo is fully aware that a constitutional amendment for extending or allowing consecutive terms for the president does not apply to the president in office at the time of the proposal. Reports that he left open the possibility of the sitting president’s re-election are entirely contrary to the intent of his remarks." A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Honam region said, "The Speaker has made the situation very difficult. He needs to quickly acknowledge his mistake and resolve it himself; otherwise, the issue will snowball." (논란이 커지자 국회의장실은 수습에 나섰다. 장현주 공보소통수석은 기자들에게 “조 의장은 대통령 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위한 헌법 개정은 제안 당시 대통령에게는 적용되지 않는다는 내용을 충분히 인식하고 있다. 현직 대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어뒀다는 보도는 발언 취지와 전혀 다르다”고 말했다. 한 호남지역 민주당 의원은 “의장이 상황을 아주 곤란하게 만들었다”며 “결자해지 차원에서 자신이 직접 실수했다고 빨리 수습하지 않으면 사태가 일파만파가 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Party Convention Kicks Off in Chungcheong Region…Voter Turnout of “One Member, One Vote” Rights-Bearing Members Emerges as Key Variable (충청서 막오른 전대…‘1인 1표’ 권리당원 투표율이 변수)
item.description:
The electoral college voting to elect the new party leader of the Democratic Party of Korea began on the 28th, starting with the online voting of rights-bearing party members in the Chungcheong region. This party convention marks the first application of the "one member, one vote" system, where delegates and rights-bearing members have equal voting weight, making the turnout of over 1.52 million rights-bearing members a variable that could determine the outcome. (더불어민주당 새 당대표를 뽑기 위한 선거인단 투표가 28일, 충청권 권리당원 온라인 투표를 시작으로 막이 올랐다. 이번 전당대회는 대의원과 권리당원의 푯값이 같아진 ‘1인 1표제’가 처음 적용되면서 152만명이 넘는 권리당원 투표율이 결과를 가를 변수로 거론된다 .)

Candidate Kim Min-seok has been prominently featuring the slogan "100% all-member voting" in his campaign. During a meeting with rights-bearing members in Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province, he emphasized, "The party must go all out to boost turnout," adding, "We need to create a leadership that can exercise overwhelming authority through 100% participation by all party members." A first-term lawmaker from the pro-Moon faction assisting Kim told The Hankyoreh on the same day, "Supporters of candidate Jeong are already firmly united. For Kim, it’s crucial to raise the turnout of rights-bearing members in the main primary higher than it was in the preliminary primary (37.42%)." (김민석 후보는 연일 ‘100% 전당원 투표’란 구호를 선거운동 전면에 내세우고 있다. 그는 이날 경남 창원 권리당원간담회에서 “당은 무조건 투표율을 올리기 위해 전력 투구해야 된다”며 “전당원 100% 투표로 압도적인 리더십을 행사할 수 있는 지도부를 만들어야 한다”고 목소리를 높였다. 김 후보를 돕는 친명계 초선 의원은 이날 한겨레에 “정 후보 지지 권리당원들은 이미 강고하게 결집돼 있어, 김 후보로선 본경선에서 권리당원 투표율을 예비경선 때(37.42%)보다 높여야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae encouraged participation while highlighting the "one member, one vote" system. During a party member meeting in Sejong City, Jeong stated, "There are forces trying to shake the one member, one vote system," and added, "To defend one member, one vote and prevent even a single stroke from undermining a party where members’ rights are sovereign, Jeong Cheong-rae must be elected." An aide to Jeong expressed a principled stance on the turnout of rights-bearing members, saying, "Under the one member, one vote system, which Jeong actively pushed to introduce, it is naturally desirable for as many party members as possible to vote and exercise their rights." (정청래 후보는 투표 참여를 독려하면서도 ‘1인 1표제’를 집중 부각했다. 정 후보는 세종시 당원 간담회에서 “1인 1표를 흔들려는 세력이 있다”며 “1인 1표를 사수하고 1인 1표 당원 주권 정당에 대해 일점일획도 손대지 못하도록 하려면, 정청래가 당선돼야 된다”고 말했다. 정 후보 쪽 관계자는 “정 후보가 적극적으로 추진해 도입된 1인 1표 체제에서 가능한 한 많은 당원이 투표에 참여해 권리를 행사하는 것이 당연히 바람직하다”며 권리당원 투표율에 대한 원론적 입장을 밝혔다.)

The candidates continued their verbal sparring, raising topics such as the party-presidential office relationship and the unification of the progressive camp. Kim said, "I will ensure that the president is not unfairly attacked for things that are wrong," and "If there is baseless criticism of the president and the government, I will firmly criticize them, whether they are from the opposition or within the progressive democratic forces, and call out what needs to be called out." This is interpreted as a jab at writer Yoo Si-min and others who have sharply criticized President Lee Jae-myung’s governance approach. (후보들은 당-청 관계, 진보 진영 통합 등을 화두로 던지며 기싸움도 이어갔다. 김 후보는 “틀린 것으로 대통령이 억울하게 공격을 당하는 일이 없게 하겠다”, “근거 없이 대통령과 정부를 비난하고 비판한다면 야당이건, 진보 민주세력 내에 비난자이건 단호하게 비판하고 짚을 것은 짚겠다”고 했다. 이는 이재명 대통령 국정운영 기조에 대해 신랄한 비판을 쏟아낸 유시민 작가 등을 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Candidate Jeong focused on delivering messages of progressive camp unity, starting with a visit to the grave of former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan, whom he regards as his political mentor. At a special lecture by the National Women’s Vision Forum in Jeonju, North Jeolla Province, Jeong said, "We need to create a one-on-one matchup in the next presidential election," and asked, "Shouldn’t the pan-democratic progressive forces field a single winning card, a single presidential candidate, to establish a democratic government?" (정 후보는 자신이 정치적 대부로 꼽는 이해찬 전 총리 묘역 참배를 시작으로 진보 진영 통합 메시지를 내놓는 데 열중했다. 그는 전북 전주에서 열린 전국여성비전포럼 특강에 참석해 “다음 대선은 일대일 구도를 만들어야 한다”며 “범민주 진보세력은 단 한장의 필승 카드, 한명의 대선 후보를 내야 민주정부를 수립할 수 있지 않겠나”라고 말했다.)

In contrast, candidate Song Young-gil attempted to differentiate himself by openly criticizing the government’s real estate policies. At a party member meeting in Chungju, North Chungcheong Province, he said, "I think we’re heading for big trouble with this real estate policy. A year into the administration, they should be focusing on (housing) supply. How can you stabilize real estate just by imposing taxes and financial regulations?" (반면 송영길 후보는 정부의 부동산정책을 공개 비판하면서 차별화를 시도하려 했다. 그는 충북 충주에서 연 당원 간담회에서 “부동산 이렇게 하다가 큰일 난다고 생각한다. 집권 1년이 지났는데 (주택) 공급을 집중적으로 해야지, 세금 때리고 금융 규제만 해서 어떻게 부동산을 잡나”라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, sharp voices emerged over a server error that delayed the online voting for rights-bearing members in the Chungcheong region, which began at 9 a.m. on the same day, by about an hour in some areas. Supreme Council candidate Kim Yong, a pro-Lee (Jae-myung) figure, wrote on Facebook, "A party member’s vote is the sovereignty of the Democratic Party, yet that sovereignty was halted for over an hour." Considering the delay caused by the server error, the voting for rights-bearing members in North and South Chungcheong Province was extended by one hour, running until 10 p.m. (한편 이날 오전 9시부터 시작된 충청권 권리당원 온라인 투표가 서버 오류로 일부 지역에서 1시간가량 지연된 것에 대해 날 선 목소리가 나왔다. 친명(이재명)계인 김용 최고위원 후보는 페이스북에 “당원 한표는 민주당 주권인데 그 주권이 한시간 넘게 멈춰 있었다”고 썼다. 서버 오류로 인한 지연 조처를 고려해 이날 충북·충남 권리당원 투표는 기존보다 1시간 연장된 밤 10시까지 진행됐다.)

item.title: Government: “Japan Silent on Forced Labor of Koreans Even 10 Years After Battleship Island’s UNESCO Listing” (정부 “일본, 군함도 등재 10년 지나도 조선인 강제노동 침묵”)
item.description:
On the 28th, the South Korean government stated at the UNESCO World Heritage Committee that Japan has failed to properly inform about the history of forced labor of Koreans, even 10 years after the Meiji Industrial Revolution sites were inscribed as a World Heritage site. (정부가 28일 유네스크 세계유산위원회에서 일본이 메이지 시대 산업혁명 유산이 세계유산으로 등재된 지 10년이 지났음에도 조선인의 강제노동 역사 등을 제대로 알리지 않고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Ambassador Kim Ji-hee of the Permanent Delegation of the Republic of Korea to UNESCO said at the 48th session of the UNESCO World Heritage Committee held in Busan that day, “The decisions of the World Heritage Committee regarding Japan’s Meiji Industrial Revolution sites have not been fully implemented,” and “We urge Japan to faithfully implement them and sincerely fulfill the commitments it made to the international community.” (김지희 주유네스코 대사는 이날 부산에서 열린 제48차 유네스코 세계유산위원회 회의에서 “일본 메이지 산업혁명 유산에 관한 세계유산위원회 결정사항이 충분히 이행되지 않고 있다”며 “일본이 (이를) 충실히 이행하고 스스로 국제사회에 약속한 사항을 성실히 이행할 것을 촉구한다”고 말했다.)

Since July 2015, when Japan’s Meiji Industrial Revolution sites, including Battleship Island (Hashima), were inscribed as a World Cultural Heritage site, the World Heritage Committee has consecutively requested four times that Japan “develop an interpretation strategy to allow understanding of the full history of each site.” The South Korean government has also urged Japan to sufficiently address the history of forced labor of Koreans related to the Meiji sites. (지난 2015년 7월 군함도를 비롯한 일본의 메이지 산업혁명 유산이 세계문화유산으로 등재된 뒤 세계유산위는 일본에 네차례 연속 “각 유산의 전체 역사를 이해할 수 있도록 해설전략을 마련할 것”을 요청해 왔다. 한국 정부도 메이지 유산과 관련된 조선인의 강제노동 역사를 충분히 다뤄야 한다고 일본에 촉구했다.)

Ambassador Kim also stated that day, “In particular, the exhibition content at the Tokyo Industrial Heritage Information Center still does not reflect the experiences of Koreans and others who were mobilized against their will in the 1940s and forced to labor under harsh conditions,” adding, “This is not merely an omission but a silencing of the real-life realities of people who have been so frequently excluded from the official narrative.” (김 대사는 이날도 “특히 도쿄 산업유산정보센터 전시 내용은 여전히 1940년대 본인의 의사에 반해 동원돼 가혹한 환경에서 노동을 강요받은 한국인과 다른 이들의 경험을 반영하지 못하고 있다”며 “이는 단순한 누락이 아니라, 공식적인 서사에서 너무도 자주 배제된 사람들의 실제 삶의 현실을 침묵시키는 것”이라고 말했다.)

The World Heritage Committee recommended that Japan reflect the full history of the Sado Island Gold Mines in Niigata Prefecture when they were inscribed as a World Heritage site in 2024, but deemed this also insufficient. On the 23rd, the World Heritage Committee adopted a decision once again requesting that the full history, including the forced labor of Koreans, be reflected, and demanded the submission of an additional implementation report by December 1, 2027. (세계유산위원회는 일본 니가타현 사도광산이 지난 2024년 세계유산에 등재될 당시 유산의 전체 역사를 반영할 것을 권고했지만, 이 또한 부족하다고 봤다. 세계유산위는 지난 23일 조선인 강제노동을 비롯한 전체 역사를 반영할 것을 또 한 번 요청하는 결정문을 채택하고 2027년 12월1일까지 추가 이행 보고서를 제출할 것을 요구했다.)

Summing up this situation, Ambassador Kim said, “We will continue to make every effort to support the full implementation of the World Heritage Committee’s decisions, including through constructive and sincere bilateral consultations,” and “We sincerely hope that Japan will also participate in this process with a constructive and responsible attitude to achieve meaningful progress.” (이런 상황을 포괄해 김 대사는 “앞으로도 건설적이고 성실한 양자 협의를 포함해, 세계유산위 결정사항의 완전한 이행을 지원하기 위해 모든 노력을 계속할 것”이라며 “일본도 건설적이고 책임 있는 자세로 이 과정에 참여해 의미 있는 진전을 이루길 진심으로 희망한다”고 말했다.)

However, Japan expressed its position that it has already implemented the recommendations of the World Heritage Committee. Japanese Ambassador to UNESCO Takehiro Kano said, “Japan has responded sincerely to the previous decisions (of the World Heritage Committee) and continues to engage in sincere dialogue with relevant parties,” adding, “There is no change in Japan’s position on this matter, and Japan reaffirms its resolve to continue dialogue outside the World Heritage Committee.” (그러나 일본은 세계유산위 권고를 이미 이행하고 있다는 취지의 입장을 밝혔다. 가노 다케히로 주유네스코 일본 대사는 “일본은 (세계유산위의) 이전 결정들에 성실하게 응했으며, 계속해서 관련 당사국들과 진심 어린 대화에 참여하고 있다”며 “이 사안에 대한 일본의 입장에는 변화가 없으며, 일본은 세계유산위 밖에서 대화를 계속하겠다는 결의를 재확인한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] People Power Party Ethics Committee Vice Chair Woo Jong-hwan on Party Discipline: “Lacks Justification, Who Would Accept This?” ([단독] 우종환 윤리위 부위원장, 국힘 징계에 “정당성 부족, 누가 수용하냐”)
item.description:
Amid the People Power Party’s Central Ethics Committee deciding on March 27 to initiate disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh with only three ethics committee members present—the minimum quorum—criticism has emerged from within the committee itself that this could undermine procedural legitimacy. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 지난 27일 최하 정족수인 단 3명의 윤리위원만 참석한 가운데 조경태, 권영진, 진종오 의원들의 징계 개시 결정을 한 것을 두고, 윤리위 내부에서도 절차적 정당성 확보에 문제가 될 수 있다는 지적이 나왔다.)

Central Ethics Committee Vice Chair Woo Jong-hwan said in a phone call with The Hankyoreh on March 28: “The directive that the Ethics Committee should be composed of nine or fewer members implies it should have a number close to nine. With a total of five members, even a majority of one is insufficient to ensure legitimacy. If only three attend, meeting the quorum, and a majority approves, who would accept that such a decision is made?” He added, “Since the disciplinary process has been initiated, I plan to attend future meetings and express my views if the timing aligns. The next meeting has not yet been confirmed.” (우종환 중앙윤리위 부위원장은 28일 한겨레와의 통화에서 “윤리위를 9명 이하로 구성하라는 건, 적어도 9명이 근접한 숫자를 가지고 구성해야 하는 것”이라며 “총인원 5명이면 과반을 한명 넘겨 정당성을 갖기도 부족한 숫자다. 그 중 3명 참석해서 의결 정족수를 충족시키고 과반 찬성해서 (징계가) 결정되는 거면 누가 수용할 수 있겠나”라고 말했다. 그러면서 “징계 개시가 됐으니 앞으로 시간만 맞다면 회의에 참석해 의견을 낼 것”이라며 “아직 다음 회의는 확정되지 않았다”고 말했다.)

Vice Chair Woo pointed to the Ethics Committee’s guidelines—stating that discipline can be imposed if it is judged that a member “repeatedly, systematically, and persistently undermines the party leader,” etc.—as the most significant issue. He said, “They should remove phrases that seem like a loyalty pledge to the party leader and provide objective, reasonable guidelines related to election laws, criminal laws, events affecting party approval ratings, and the next general election.” (우 부위원장은 윤리위가 ‘반복적이고 조직, 지속적으로 당 대표 등을 저해한다고 판단되면 징계할 수 있다’는 징계 가이드라인을 제시한 것을 가장 큰 문제로 지적했다. 그는 “당대표 충성 맹세용으로 보이는 문구를 빼고, 선거법이나 형사법, 당 지지율과 다음 총선에 영향을 미치는 사건 등 객관적이고 수긍할만한 가이드라인을 줘야 한다”고 말했다.)

Vice Chair Woo also said, “While the internal strife in the Ethics Committee has flared up recently, Chairman Yoon Min-woo’s unilateral operating style existed before as well. Regarding the Bae Hyun-jin lawmaker case (where the committee imposed the heavy sanction of a one-year suspension of party membership), I suggested sharing the draft disciplinary decision in advance to review it together, but it was not accepted.” (우 부위원장은 또한 “윤리위 내홍은 최근에 불거졌지만, 윤민우 윤리위원장의 독단적인 운영 방식이 이전에도 있었다”며 “(윤리위가 당원권 1년 정지라는 중징계를 했던) 배현진 의원 사건과 관련해 징계 결정문을 쓸 때 미리 공유해서 함께 검토하자고 제안했지만 받아들여지지 않았다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the rumor that he is close to the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, Vice Chair Woo explained, “I don’t know why such baseless talk is circulating. Although I was appointed by Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, I have never met him personally. I became an ethics committee member on the recommendation of party officials.” The vice chair position was filled through an election. (우 부위원장은 친한동훈계와 가깝다는 설에 관련해 “말도 안 되는 얘기가 왜 나오는 모르겠다”며 “장동혁 대표가 임명했지만, 장 대표와 개인적으로 만난 적은 없다. 당 관계자들의 추천으로 윤리위원을 맡게 됐다”고 설명했다. 부위원장은 호선으로 임명됐다.)

The People Power Party leadership launched the Ethics Committee in January with seven members. However, three committee members immediately resigned after their names were disclosed. The party then appointed two new members, restoring the committee to six. Following the June 3 local elections, it added Jeong Kyeong-uk, the party’s media spokesperson, to bring the number to seven again. But due to conflicts intensifying over Chairman Yoon Min-woo’s operating policies, two committee members resigned in succession within a week, reducing the committee to its current five members. Against this backdrop, Vice Chair Woo and committee member Hwang Kyung-sung issued a statement on March 27 criticizing Chairman Yoon and boycotted the meeting, during which the decision to open disciplinary proceedings against Cho Kyoung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh was made. (국민의힘 지도부는 지난 1월 7명 체제로 윤리위를 출범시켰다. 그러나 명단이 공개됐다는 이유로 윤리위원 3명이 바로 사퇴했다. 이후 국민의힘은 2명을 새로 임명해 다시 6명 체제를 꾸렸다. 6·3 지방선거 뒤 정경욱 당 미디어대변인을 추가 임명해 다시 7명 체제를 만들었으나, 최근 윤민우 위원장의 운영방침에 대한 반발 탓에 갈등이 격화하면서 일주일 새 윤리위원 2명이 잇달아 사퇴해 현재 5명으로 줄었다. 이런 가운데 우 부위원장과 황경성 위원은 지난 27일 윤민우 위원장을 비판하는 성명을 내고 회의에 불참한 상황에서, 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 결정했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hong Myung-bo Spent 14 Million Won on Corporate Card Near His Home… Including Payments at Meat Restaurants (홍명보, 집 근처서 법카 1400만원 써…고깃집 등 결제)
item.description:
Former national football team coach Hong Myung-bo used his corporate card to spend approximately 14 million won over about two years, mostly near his residence. (홍명보 전 축구 국가대표팀 감독이 법인카드로 자택 근처에서만 약 2년간 1400여만원을 쓴 것으로 나타났다.)

According to the Korea Football Association's (KFA) corporate card usage records submitted to lawmaker Jin Seon-mi of the Democratic Party of Korea, Hong spent 14.06 million won out of a total of 37.42 million won in corporate card payments over one year and ten months—from July 2024 to last May—in Bundang-gu, Seongnam City, Gyeonggi Province, near his home. (진선미 더불어민주당 의원실이 대한축구협회(축협)로부터 제출받은 협회의 법인카드 사용 내역을 보면, 홍 전 감독은 2024년 7월부터 지난 5월까지 1년10개월 동안 법인카드 결제액 3742만원 중 1406만원을 집 근처인 경기 성남시 분당구에서 쓴 것으로 돼 있다.)

The payment locations included a hotel, a butcher restaurant, and a hangover soup restaurant near his residence. He also made payments amounting to hundreds of thousands of won at establishments in Bundang on public holidays such as Children's Day, Memorial Day, and Liberation Day. The KFA has regulations restricting the use of corporate cards on holidays or in areas far from the association's offices, and requires objective supporting documents or explanatory statements even in unavoidable cases. (결제 장소는 자택 인근 호텔과 정육식당, 해장국집 등이었다. 어린이날과 현충일, 광복절 등 공휴일에도 분당에 있는 업소에서 수십만 원을 결제했다. 축협은 휴일이나 축협과 먼 지역에서의 법인카드 사용을 제한하고, 불가피하게 쓰더라도 객관적인 증빙자료나 소명서를 제출하도록 규정하고 있다.)

The KFA stated that it did not receive an explanation from former coach Hong regarding the transactions made near his home. However, the association maintains that there is no issue because Hong recorded the attendees and their numbers on receipts, and the association reviewed the usage on a monthly basis. (축협은 홍 전 감독으로부터 집 근처에서 결제한 내용의 소명서를 제출받진 않았다고 한다. 그러나 홍 감독이 영수증에 참석자와 인원 등을 기재했고, 월 1회 사용 내용을 점검했기 때문에 문제는 없다는 입장이다.)

Lawmaker Jin said, "It is urgent to reorganize the corporate card management system, including strengthening the verification and review procedures for exceptional payments." (진 의원은 “(법인카드) 예외적 결제에 대한 증빙과 점검 절차를 강화하는 등 법인카드 관리체계 재정비가 시급하다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Revision of the Criminal Procedure Act Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Passes Judiciary Subcommittee (‘보완수사권 폐지’ 형사소송법 개정안, 법사위 소위 통과)
item.description:
On the 28th, the First Subcommittee of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the National Assembly passed a revision of the Criminal Procedure Act led by the Democratic Party of Korea, abolishing the prosecutor's supplementary investigation powers. (국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사제1소위원회가 28일 더불어민주당 주도로 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지한 형사소송법 개정안을 통과시켰다.)

Kim Seung-won, a lawmaker from the ruling party serving as the secretary on the National Assembly's Judiciary Committee and chair of the First Subcommittee, told reporters after the subcommittee meeting that evening, "The revision of the Criminal Procedure Act was resolved in the First Subcommittee." (국회 법사위 여당 간사이자 제1소위원장인 김승원 의원은 이날 밤 소위 회의를 마친 뒤 취재진에 “형사소송법 개정안을 1소위에서 의결했다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Revised Criminal Procedure Act Abolishing Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Rights Passes Subcommittee... Led by Democratic Party (‘보완수사권 폐지’ 형사소송법 개정안 소위 통과…민주당 주도)
item.description:
A revised Criminal Procedure Act abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights passed the first subcommittee of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 28th, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. The Democratic Party plans to pass the revision at the plenary session on the 30th after going through the full Legislation and Judiciary Committee meeting on the 28th. (검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 28일 국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사제1소위원회에서 더불어민주당 주도로 통과됐다. 민주당은 28일 법사위 전체회의를 거쳐 30일 본회의에서 개정안을 통과시킬 계획이다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Seung-won, the ruling party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and chair of the first subcommittee, met with reporters around 11:10 p.m. that night after the subcommittee adjourned and announced that the subcommittee had approved the revised Criminal Procedure Act, which centers on abolishing supplementary investigation rights. Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee left the meeting room before the subcommittee's vote in opposition to the abolition of supplementary investigation rights. (법사위 여당 간사이자 제1소위원장인 김승원 민주당 의원은 이날 밤 11시10분께 소위 산회 뒤 기자들을 만나 보완수사권 폐지를 뼈대로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 소위에서 의결했다고 밝혔다. 국민의힘 소속 법사위원들은 보완수사권 폐지에 반발해 소위 의결 전 회의장에서 퇴장했다.)

The revised Criminal Procedure Act passed by the subcommittee excludes prosecutors from being investigation subjects. This was achieved by completely deleting Article 196 of the current law, which stipulates that "when a prosecutor believes there is suspicion of a crime, they investigate the suspect, criminal facts, and evidence." (소위를 통과한 형사소송법 개정안은 검사를 수사 주체에서 제외했다. ‘검사는 범죄의 혐의가 있다고 사료하는 때에는 법인, 범죄사실과 증거를 수사한다’고 규정한 현행법 196조를 전면 삭제하면서다.)

Instead, the Democratic Party stated it would enhance the effectiveness of the right to request supplementary investigations through the revision. The revision includes provisions that when a prosecutor requests a supplementary investigation, the police must conduct it within one month, and if completing the investigation within one month is difficult, it can be extended by one month. (민주당은 대신 개정안을 통해 보완수사요구권의 실효성을 높이겠다고 밝혔다. 개정안에는 검사가 보완수사를 요구하면 경찰은 1개월 안에 보완수사를 해야 하며, 1개월 안에 수사 마무리가 어려우면 1개월을 연장할 수 있게 하는 내용이 담겼다.)

The revision also allows not only complainants and victims but also accusers to file objections against police decisions not to forward cases to the prosecution. This is a measure to expand victim protection. The right to access and copy case records necessary for objections has also been granted. (경찰의 불송치 결정에 대해 고소인과 피해자뿐 아니라 고발인도 이의 신청을 할 수 있게 하는 내용도 담겼다. 피해자 보호 확대를 위한 조처다. 이의신청에 필요한 사건 기록 열람과 등사 권한도 부여됐다.)

Lawmaker Kim Seung-won also stated, "For cases not forwarded to the prosecution, the reasons, methods, period, and processing procedures for re-investigation requests have been clarified, and when a prosecutor discovers new criminal suspicions related to cases forwarded or transferred, they can request an investigation from the competent investigative agency." (김승원 의원은 “불송치 사건에 대해서는 재수사 요구의 사유와 방법, 기간 및 처리 절차를 명확히 하고, 검사가 송치 또는 송부된 사건과 관련해 새로운 범죄 혐의를 발견한 경우 관할 수사 기관에 수사를 요청할 수 있도록 했다”고도 전했다.)

The current law provision requiring police to obtain prosecution 'approval' when making emergency arrests has been maintained. A revision to allow police to only 'notify' prosecutors during emergency arrests was also considered, but it was decided to retain the current provision after subcommittee discussions. Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Han-gyu said, "Even if the provisions defining prosecutors' investigation authority are deleted, we do not judge it as unconstitutional." (경찰이 피의자를 긴급 체포할 때 검사의 ‘승인’을 받도록 하는 현행법 조항은 유지됐다. 경찰이 긴급 체포 시 검사에 ‘통보’만 하도록 하는 개정도 검토됐지만 소위 논의 끝에 유지하기로 한 것으로, 김한규 민주당 의원은 “검사의 수사권을 규정한 조항이 삭제되더라도 위헌이라고 판단하지 않는다”고 말했다.)

Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee opposed the forced legislation to abolish supplementary investigation rights. People Power Party lawmaker Park Hyung-su, after leaving the meeting room and meeting reporters, said, "The Democratic Party has organized (the revision) according to their script, and while they made us stand as props all day, they even prepared a table of clauses," adding, "Shouldn't they give us time to review (the table of clauses)? There's no point in continuing the subcommittee since proceedings are moving forward without that." (국민의힘 소속 법사위원들은 보완수사권 폐지 입법 강행에 반대했다. 박형수 국민의힘 의원은 회의장에서 퇴장하며 기자들을 만나 “민주당이 각본대로 (개정안을) 다 정리해놓고 우리는 종일 들러리 세우면서 조문표까지 다 만들어놨다”며 “우리가 (조문표를) 검토할 시간을 줘야 할 것 아닌가. 그런 것도 없이 진행하고 있어서 더는 소위를 할 의미가 없다”고 말했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Kim Tae-kyu said, "They are rushing through this procedure like roasting beans over lightning, claiming to align with the party convention schedule, but sensible legal experts cannot accept this." The People Power Party announced plans to filibuster (lawful obstruction of proceedings for unlimited debate) in opposition to processing the revised Criminal Procedure Act. (김태규 국민의힘 의원은 “주당 전당대회에 맞춰서 이 절차를 진행하겠다고 번갯불에 콩 볶아먹듯이 하는데 상식 있는 법률가는 여기에 수긍하지 못한다”고 말했다. 국민의힘은 형사소송법 개정안 처리에 반대해 필리버스터(무제한 토론을 위한 합법적 의사진행 방해) 실시를 예고했다.)

item.title: Controversy Over Extension of Incumbent President’s Term… Cho Jung-sik: “Not Subject to Constitutional Amendment” (현직 대통령 연임 논란 일자…조정식 “개헌 대상 아냐”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik stated on the 28th, “Extending the term of the incumbent president is not a subject for constitutional amendment discussions,” adding, “I regret that it has caused misunderstandings and controversy contrary to my intentions.” (조정식 국회의장은 28일 “현직 대통령의 연임은 개헌 논의대상이 아니다”라며 “본의와 다르게 오해와 논란을 불러일으킨 점에 대해 유감스럽게 생각한다”고 밝혔다.)

In a Facebook post that evening, Speaker Cho wrote, “Article 128, Section 2 of our Constitution stipulates that even if a constitutional amendment is made to extend the president’s term or change term limits, it does not apply to the president in office at the time of the amendment.” He further emphasized, “The content of Article 128, Section 2 must be respected, and extending the term of the incumbent president is not a subject of future constitutional amendment discussions.” (조 의장은 이날 밤 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “우리 헌법 128조 2항은 ‘대통령 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위한 개헌이 이루어지더라도 개헌 당시 대통령에게는 적용되지 않는다’고 규정하고 있다”며 “헌법 128조 2항의 내용은 존중되어야 하며, 향후 이루어질 개헌 논의에 현직 대통령의 연임은 그 대상이 아니다”고 썼다.)

Speaker Cho explained, “My response at today’s (28th) press conference was about the basic procedures—that constitutional amendments, including restructuring the power structure, can only be achieved through consensus among political actors and the choice of the people.” He added, “I regret that it caused unintended misunderstandings and controversy.” (조 의장은 “오늘(28일) 기자간담회에서의 답변은 권력구조 개편을 포함해 개헌이 이루어지기 위해서는 정치 주체 간의 합의와 국민의 선택이 있어야만 가능하다는 취지의 기본 절차를 밝힌 것”이라며 “본의와 다르게 오해와 논란을 불러일으킨 점에 대해 유감스럽게 생각한다”고도 했다.)

Speaker Cho also stated, “As I mentioned at the press conference, I will do my utmost to advance constitutional amendments centered on topics that the ruling and opposition parties can agree on and that the public supports, opening a future for the Republic of Korea.” (조 의장은 “기자간담회에서도 밝혔듯이 여야가 합의 가능하고 국민이 찬성하는 개헌주제들을 중심으로 개헌을 추진해 대한민국의 미래를 열어가는 데 최선의 노력을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Earlier that morning, during his first press conference since taking office, Speaker Cho responded to a question about the opposition’s opposition to extending the incumbent president’s term by saying, “The issue of amending the constitution for the incumbent president’s term extension is ultimately a matter of public opinion and the choice of the sovereign people.” (앞서 조 의장은 이날 오전 한 취임 뒤 첫 기자간담회에서 ‘야권에서 현직 대통령의 임기 연장 개헌을 반대한다’는 취지의 질문에 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌 문제 등은 결국 주권자인 국민 여론과 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말한 바 있다.)

Speaker Cho’s remarks were interpreted as opening the door to the possibility of extending the incumbent president’s term, which is constitutionally impossible, sparking controversy. Criticism poured in, particularly from the opposition, with People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk writing on Facebook, “Finally, they have revealed their true intention (for President Lee to extend his term).” (조 의장의 발언은 헌법상 불가능한 현직 대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어두는 취지의 발언으로 해석되며 논란이 커졌다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 페이스북에 “드디어 (이 대통령이 임기 연장하겠다는) 검은 속내를 드러낸 것”이라고 쓰는 등 야당을 중심으로 비판이 쏟아졌다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yean chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Says "Summit Diplomacy Greatly Aids Economic Exchange"... Highlights Overseas Visit Benefits in Brazil (이 대통령 “정상외교가 경제교류에 큰 도움”… 브라질서 순방 효과 강조)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a state visit to Brazil, met with Korean compatriots in Brazil on the 28th (local time) and said, "Since taking office, I have made quite a number of overseas visits," adding, "These kinds of meetings between national leaders greatly help economic and security cooperation, as well as civilian exchanges." (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 28일(현지시각) 브라질 동포들을 만나 “제가 취임한 이후로 해외 순방을 많이 다닌 편”이라며 “국가 정상 간의 이런 만남이 경제·안보 협력, 민간 교류에 크게 도움이 된다”고 말했다.)

At a meeting with compatriots held at a hotel in São Paulo that day, President Lee stated, "When (between leaders) we build substantive trust, companies that have already entered the market, local residents here, and companies exporting products from this country all see their situations rapidly improve," adding, "That's why I'm visiting as many countries as possible early in my term and normalizing or deepening relations between nations." <<> President Lee also mentioned the summit with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva the previous day. President Lee said, "President Lula asked me to pass along his regards to everyone. Really," and added with a smile, "Maybe that's because there are elections coming up soon." Continuing, President Lee remarked, "President Lula said that the only presidents in the world with working-class backgrounds are you and me," and noted, "He said, 'How many people truly run with all their hearts to solve the world's difficulties? Let's both work hard.' He is a remarkable person." <<> President Lee added, "(President Lula) oversaw rapid growth in the Brazilian economy during his two previous terms, didn't he? Income inequality and educational inequality also improved dramatically," and continued, "That must have greatly contributed to Brazil's economic development and national progress." <<> On this day, President Lee also presented appreciation plaques to four first-generation compatriots who migrated to Brazil in the 1950s to 1970s. <<> São Paulo/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이날 상파울루 한 호텔에서 열린 동포간담회에서 “(정상 간) 실질적인 신뢰를 쌓으면 현재 진출한 기업들도 또 현지의 교민들도, 또 이 나라의 상품을 수출하는 기업들도 매우 상황이 신속하게 개선된다”며 “그래서 임기 초 최대한 많은 나라를 방문하고 또 국가 간 관계를 정상화하거나 더 심화하기 위해 많이 다니는 편”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Korea-Brazil Economic Cooperation Has Great Potential... Anticipating Results in Supply Chain Cooperation" (이 대통령 “한·브라질 경제협력 잠재력 커… 공급망 협력 성과 기대”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Brazil, said on the 28th (local time), "If Korea's unparalleled innovative technology and manufacturing capabilities combine with Brazil's abundant resources, our two countries can leap forward as optimal partners leading stable supply chains and future industries together." (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 28일(현지시각) “한국의 독보적인 혁신 기술과 제조 역량, 브라질의 풍부한 자원이 힘을 합친다면 우리 양국은 안정적인 공급망과 미래산업을 함께 이끄는 최적의 파트너로 도약할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

At the "Korea-Brazil Business Roundtable" held at a hotel in São Paulo that day, President Lee stated, "Since the relationship between Korea and Brazil was elevated to a strategic partnership last January, we must now discover many projects for bilateral collaboration," adding, "Brazil is already Korea's largest trading partner in South America, and Korean companies' entry into Brazil is gradually increasing." ( 이 대통령은 이날 상파울루 한 호텔에서 열린 ‘한·브라질 비즈니스 라운드테이블’에서 “지난 1월 한국, 브라질 양국관계가 전략적 동반자 관계로 격상된 만큼 이제 양국이 협업할 수 있는 프로젝트를 많이 발굴해 나가야겠다”며 “이미 브라질은 대한민국의 남미 최대 교역국이고, 한국의 브라질 진출도 점차 늘어나고 있다”고 말했다. )

President Lee further added, "Considering the economic scale of both countries, the potential for economic cooperation between the two nations is very large," but noted, "However, the trade volume between the two countries is still very small compared to this potential." <<> Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva also mentioned in a joint press conference following the Korea-Brazil summit the previous day, "The trade volume between the two countries in 2025 recorded approximately $11 billion," and expressed confidence that "after today's summit, next year's trade volume will be much larger than this." <<> President Lee said, "Going forward, I anticipate great results in three areas: supply chain cooperation in key mineral sectors, including joint development of next-generation civilian aircraft, and even K-beauty, which is enjoying sensational popularity," adding, "If the businesspeople of both countries join forces, Korea and Brazil can grow together as a strong aviation manufacturing nation leading the global aircraft market, an important partner in supply chain cooperation, and furthermore, a leader in the global beauty market." <<> Meanwhile, regarding the joint statement annexes signed during President Lee's state visit, Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said in a written briefing, "Among them, the 'Joint Statement between the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy of the Republic of Korea and the Ministry of Mines and Energy of the Federative Republic of Brazil on Critical Strategic Minerals' emphasizes building a resilient and diversified supply chain for critical minerals, including rare earths, and promoting shared prosperity through local processing and value-added creation." The two countries agreed that critical and strategic minerals play a key role in energy and digital transitions, technological applications, and sustainable economic development. <<> São Paulo / Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이어 “양국의 경제 규모를 고려할 때 양국의 경제 협력의 잠재력은 매우 크다”며 “그러나 양국간 교역 규모는 이 잠재력이 비하면 매우 적다고 할 수 있다”고 덧붙였다. )

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Stock Price Volatility to be Reviewed for Structural Factors Including Single-Stock Leveraged ETFs" (김용범 “주가 변동성, 단일종목 레버리지 포함 구조적 요인 점검”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office policy office, who accompanied President Lee Jae-myung on his state visit to Brazil, said on the 28th (local time), “Regarding structural factors that make (stock market) volatility particularly pronounced, we plan to have the Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service conduct a comprehensive review, not only of (single-stock) leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) but also of overall aspects.” <<> At a local briefing that day, Director Kim stated, “The reason our country has high volatility is due to the large proportion of individual investors, dynamic investment patterns, and many related derivatives. Additionally, the very large market share of these two companies (Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix) interacts with various characteristics, leading to significant volatility. Over the past two to three months, however, this is not unique to us.” <<> Director Kim continued, “The debate over the overall direction of semiconductor and AI stocks continues,” adding, “Investors still lack full confidence in the progression of the AI revolution. However, I do not believe that actual demand or the use cases of AI are temporary. I see demand as steadily continuing, and I view this as a process of finding a balance point.” <<> He further noted the recent impact of a “semiconductor shock originating from China.” CXMT, China’s fourth-largest DRAM manufacturer, went public, and China succeeded in mass-producing DUV lithography equipment, causing the KOSPI to close at 6,023.66 on the 28th, down 732.09 points (10.84%) from the previous trading day. <<> Director Kim remarked, “With CXMT listing, combined with the equipment news, it resembles the old ‘DeepSeek shock.’ From China’s perspective, they will likely try to nurture these two companies over the long term, and one could think China is advancing because it has strengths in technology and other areas.” He added, “Rather, I interpret this shock as a signal for us to build fabs in a timely manner, invest adequately, and pay more attention to R&D.” <<> Director Kim’s remarks are interpreted as conveying that, while China’s memory semiconductor technology is rapidly catching up, this should not be seen solely as a crisis. Instead, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix should expand facility investments and R&D in a timely manner to maintain their initial lead. <<> São Paulo/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령의 브라질 국빈 방문에 동행한 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 28일(현지시각) “(주식 시장) 변동성이 유독 도드라지는 구조적 요인에 대해 (단일종목) 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)뿐 아니라 전반적으로 금융위원회, 금융감독원에서 점검해보려고 한다”고 말했다.)
